planets.name: XO-2 N b
planets.description: Transiting planet of XO-2 N with a 2.62-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: XO-2 N b was found in 2007 by XO as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around XO-2 N. Its orbit and size follow Ruggieri et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
